args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 (seq 3) was the latest deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback action taken.
